pages.text: The current main production line: the $(reset)only source$(reset) that refines Life Energy from Akaishi Energy.$(br2)$(bold)Building it:$(reset)$(li)Frame a $(reset)3×3×3$(reset) hollow sealed box with Life Conversion Matrix Casings$(li)Put an Energy Input Port and a Life Output Port into the walls$(li)Mount the controller $(reset)on a wall$(reset) — once the structure forms it runs automatically; breaking any casing stops it immediately$(br2)$(bold)Rates:$(reset) up to $(reset)45$(reset) conversions per tick, each burning $(reset)10M Akaishi Energy$(reset) for $(reset)10 Life Energy$(reset) — about 450 Life/tick at full speed, demanding ~450M akaishi/tick. $(bold)Ensure the grid can sustain it before switching it on$(reset).

$(bold)Energy Input Port$(reset): a $(reset)100M$(reset) buffer that feeds the controller every tick, smoothing the 10M draw of each conversion.$(br2)$(bold)Life Output Port$(reset): pulls up to $(reset)450$(reset) Life Energy per tick (at full output) into its own 5,000 buffer for Life Energy Pipes to drain.$(br2)$(bold)Pipe rule:$(reset) akaishi energy goes in, life energy comes out; do not swap them.

pages.title: Outdated Machines
pages.text: $(bold)Outdated machines$(reset): the older $(reset)Life Aggregation Converter$(reset) and $(reset)Life Conversion Architecture$(reset) have $(bold)been replaced by the Matrix$(reset). They now serve only as $(reset)crafting materials$(reset) with an energy buffer — they never run or form a structure on their own.$(br2)They can be used as building materials, but they no longer refine Life Energy.
Storage and transport: "$(l:akaishi:life_energy)Life Energy$(/l)". The refined energy is next solidified into currency at the "$(l:akaishi:life_purifier)Life Energy Purifier$(/l)".
